intro.title: New Construction Homes in Portland Metro & Southwest Washington
intro.description: Compare active and upcoming new-home communities, builders, cities and the tradeoffs that matter before you walk into a model home. Availability, incentives and phases can change quickly, so every community below includes a verification source.

builders.summary: Oregon builder focused on semi-custom, Earth Advantage-certified homes in Portland-area communities.

incentives.headline: Get Up to $35K in Credit Toward Your Dream Home
incentives.description: Apply up to $25,000 toward building costs, closing costs, finish upgrades, or a rate buydown on a pre-sale semi-custom home. Apply up to $35,000 toward closing costs, finish upgrades, or a rate buydown on a move-in ready home. Must be in contract by 2026-08-31 (and close by 2026-09-30 for move-in ready homes). Portland market only. Limit one incentive per sale. Partnered rate buydown available through CMG Home Loans (includes up to $35,000 Stone Bridge contribution plus a 1% lender credit). See official offer page for full terms.
incentives.appliesTo: Portland market — pre-sale semi-custom and select move-in ready homes (see terms)
incentives.requirements: Must be in contract by 2026-08-31; move-in ready homes must also close by 2026-09-30. Portland market only; limit one incentive per sale. Additional lender/program requirements apply for buydown.

feedMeta.note: This file is the website input contract. A future upstream job may replace or merge builder/community records.
feedMeta.researchMethod: One low-reasoning, low-context OpenAI Responses API web-search call per tracked builder, restricted to the builder official domain. No high-reasoning fallback and no SDK retries. Missing optional facts are omitted instead of chased. Community card images are read directly from official community-page social metadata with no additional AI call.
